symbols.name: imaginary unit
symbols.meaning: The complex number whose square is $-1$.
symbols.quote: Here $i$ is the imaginary unit, the number with $i^2=-1$.

symbols.name: Gaussian integers
symbols.meaning: The set of all Gaussian integers.
symbols.quote: Write $\mathbb{Z}[i]$ for the set of all Gaussian integers.

symbols.name: dyadic Gaussian integers
symbols.meaning: The Gaussian integers divided by powers of two.
symbols.quote: The paper's arrays take entries in $\mathbb{Z}[i,1/2]$, the Gaussian integers divided by powers of two.

relations.quote: Gaussian integers keep exact the outputs of a [Discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md) of length $4$, which is normalized by $1/4$.
